tex_content.html:
Proposition
[The Weingarten Equation] 1. ch8:8.4

For every $X\in \mathfrak X(M)$ and $N\in \Gamma (NM)$, egin{equation} (\widetilde abla _XN)^ op =-W_N(X), ag {8.5} \end{equation} where $N$ is extended arbitrarily to a neighborhood of $M$ in $\widetilde M$.

Proof

\sketch For arbitrary $Y\in \mathfrak X(M)$, metric compatibility, normality of $N$, and the Gauss formula yield

egin{align*} 0=X\langle N,Y angle & =\langle \widetilde abla _XN,Y angle +\langle N,\widetilde abla _XY angle \ & =\langle \widetilde abla _XN,Y angle +\langle N,\mathrm{II}(X,Y) angle \ & =\langle (\widetilde abla _XN)^ op +W_N(X),Y angle . \end{align*}

Since $Y$ is arbitrary, (8.5) follows.

□
